params.title: WNT-verantwoording
params.description: Jaarlijkse WNT-verantwoording per topfunctionaris: de bezoldiging per jaar en de publicatiestatus. De verzameling regels van een jaar IS de WNT-verantwoording van dat jaar (wnt-disclosure).

params.title: WNT-verantwoording
params.note: wnt-disclosure: the annual WNT-verantwoording record for one topfunctionaris (PensionFilingDetail shape -- a per-period disclosure carrying a real FK, employeeId -> Employee). wd-status leads top-left with the year/totalCompensation/status facts; wd-related sits top-right at matching height to resolve and link the referenced topfunctionaris Employee (whose wntTopfunctionaris/wntUitzonderingReden drive the nl-wnt-norm-overschrijding audit); wd-data runs below with the remaining fields excluding employeeId since Related already resolves it. No stats-block (the vendored schema's metric only aggregates over a collection, cannot echo a scalar field of the current object -- PensionFilingDetail reasoning). No Files/comms/calendar leaves -- the disclosure carries no attached-document/appointment fields. lifecycleActions expose the single publiceren transition (concept -> gepubliceerd, no guard). Audit history is a sidebar tab.
